energy_doe.title: DOE industrial software tools
energy_doe.finding: MEASUR identifies industrial-system efficiency savings opportunities.

energy_caltrack.title: CalTRACK methods
energy_caltrack.finding: Avoided-energy methods compare metered usage with counterfactuals; primary use case includes procurement of energy savings. Whole-site methods do not establish process-level causal attribution.

energy_celonis.title: Celonis Process Excellence
energy_celonis.finding: An established commercial process-mining competitor offers process optimization; not evidence that the proposed industrial measurement workflow is unique.

docling.title: Docling document conversion
docling.finding: Structured document conversion and JSON export exist; correctness on a buyer corpus is untested.

ifc.title: IfcOpenShell API documentation
ifc.finding: IFC authoring and editing APIs exist. Does not prove that legacy buildings have reliable IFC files.

reuse_eu.title: EU Construction and Demolition Waste Management Protocol 2024
reuse_eu.finding: Guidance identifies pre-demolition audits, hazardous materials, reuse potential, and waste logistics as practical needs. Guidance itself is not a purchase order or blanket legal obligation.

reuse_madaster.title: Madaster platform
reuse_madaster.finding: Commercial material inventory/passport platform already supports reuse-related workflows.

water_epa.title: EPA effective water utility management
water_epa.finding: EPA identifies aging infrastructure, rising costs, and workforce challenges faced by utilities.

water_xylem.title: Xylem Vue
water_xylem.finding: Commercial leak detection and real-time water-network digital twin capabilities exist.

water_wntr.title: WNTR network model documentation
water_wntr.finding: Water network models can be constructed from EPANET INP files, subject to supported-feature limitations.

wind_doe.title: DOE smart-curtailment technology
wind_doe.finding: DOE describes an established DARC system, energy lost to blanket curtailment, and the mechanical, warranty, cybersecurity and permitting context of turbine integration.

wind_bats.title: DOE birds and bats
wind_bats.finding: Acoustic monitoring and smart curtailment are established approaches; efficacy varies by site and species.

cold_fao.title: FAO sustainable food cold chains
cold_fao.finding: FAO and UNEP identify ineffective food refrigeration as a major cause of food losses and lost livelihoods. This establishes problem scale, not willingness to pay for this particular software.

cold_who.title: WHO temperature monitoring guidance
cold_who.finding: Vaccine supply chains require product-appropriate temperature monitoring. This is evidence for the problem class, not evidence supporting a food shelf-life model or permission to release exposed vaccines.

cold_sensitech.title: Sensitech cold-chain solutions
cold_sensitech.finding: Commercial monitoring, connected devices, and facility/equipment monitoring already exist.

cold_shelf.title: Sensitech cold-chain logistical services
cold_shelf.finding: Supplier explicitly describes analysis of temperature impacts on quality and shelf life; claimed differentiation cannot simply be predictive shelf life.

mine_unep.title: UNEP Global Industry Standard on Tailings Management
mine_unep.finding: Tailings governance, risk classification, environmental protection and disclosure are established needs; not a direct procurement commitment.

mine_skygeo.title: SkyGeo mining InSAR
mine_skygeo.finding: Incumbent already combines InSAR interpretation, geotechnical expertise, ground instruments and inspection scheduling. Vendor capabilities are self-reported.

evac_cdc.title: CDC sheltering and evacuating
evac_cdc.finding: Accessible transportation and advance coordination with local government/paratransit are explicitly identified needs.

evac_hurrevac.title: HURREVAC key features
evac_hurrevac.finding: Established public-sector decision support calculates evacuation timing using storm threats and clearance information.

pyswmm.title: PySWMM quick start
pyswmm.finding: Python interfaces can read node/link simulation states; this does not itself provide street-level flood depths or safe-route certification.

pm4py.title: PM4Py research paper
pm4py.finding: Process-mining toolkit integrates event-data analysis with Python data-science libraries.
